parameters.name: AssetIP
parameters.description: The IP address of the local asset. You must specify at least one of AssetIP and Port. If both are left empty, the API returns a 400 error.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number in a paged query.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The traffic direction. Valid values:
- **in**: inbound.
- **out**: outbound.

>If you do not configure this parameter in Settings, traffic in all directions is queried.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: IPProtocol
parameters.description:
The protocol type. Valid values:
- **tcp**: TCP protocol.
- **udp**: UDP protocol.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.
-  **desc** (default): descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query.

parameters.name: PeerAssetIP
parameters.description: The source IP address of the peer.

parameters.name: PeerAssetInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the peer asset.

parameters.name: PeerAssetInstanceName
parameters.description: The instance name of the peer asset.

parameters.name: PeerVpcId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the peer VPC.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number. You must specify at least one of AssetIP and Port. If both are left empty, the API returns a 400 error.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
